title: Authorize exact subordinate clean-generation execution scopes
purpose: Create and approve four subordinate work packages on the exact ARC-WP-022 merge baseline. Runtime, authoring and contradictory-QA/fixture agents may work concurrently on disjoint paths. The integrator remains sequential and may start only after all three role outputs receive independent review.
invariants: All subordinate work packages use exact base commit d0186d7c0d65d44287c59534855ea90ffa3f8d06.
The learnit.kit.v2 schema and ARC-WP-022 file plan remain frozen.
DEV-WP-031, KIT-WP-001 and QA-WP-011 have mutually disjoint writable paths and may run in parallel.
INT-WP-001 owns all shared build, manifest, workflow and release surfaces and does not run in parallel with unreviewed implementer outputs.
No subordinate work package writes governance, architecture or work-package files through an implementation lane.
The existing fixed Remote Agent profiles do not certify learnit-next behavior; a Remote Agent status is transport evidence only until role-local validation is independently reproduced.
Each parallel role uses an independent clean branch, clone or worktree and records exact role-local validation commands and raw outputs.
No subordinate work package accesses or changes RC718 source, artifact or protected storage semantics.
No subordinate work package adds a file outside FILE_PLAN_V1.json.
The contract cannot change during implementation.
Backend, accounts, synchronization, catalog, commerce, tenancy and marketplace remain held.
requiredEvidence: Each subordinate work package passes repository governance validation.
The union of subordinate allowed paths equals the 31 implementation paths remaining after the frozen schema and contains no duplicate path.
Every subordinate forbidden-path set blocks the other roles' writable surfaces.
The three parallel roles declare exact tests, evidence and rollback.
Role-local validation commands and raw outputs are recorded and independently reproduced before integration.
The integration role declares reviewed-output prerequisites and may not modify implementer-owned files.
Repository governance and PR scope pass on the exact authorization commit.
adversarialTests: Fail authorization if any two subordinate allowed-path sets overlap.
Fail authorization if the union differs from FILE_PLAN_V1.json after excluding the frozen schema.
Fail authorization if any role can change the contract schema.
Fail authorization if any implementation role can change build, manifest, workflow or release files.
Fail authorization if the integrator can change runtime, authoring, fixture or test files.
Fail authorization if any work package omits the exact common base or rollback.
Fail authorization if a transport-only status is presented as product-test evidence.
Fail authorization if any RC718 path, compatibility layer or held platform domain is permitted.
nonGoals: Implementing any successor file in this authorization package.
Running or merging an agent result before its independent review.
Changing the v2 contract or 32-file budget.
Creating a release candidate or human test artifact.
Entering any RC718 migration or held platform domain.
independentReview: Governor verifies exact set equality and disjointness against FILE_PLAN_V1.json.
Architecture reviewer confirms runtime dependency direction and contract freeze.
Learning reviewer confirms authoring scope is limited to representative foundation kits.
Contradictory QA reviewer confirms independence from runtime implementation.
Integrator reviewer confirms no shared writable file exists among parallel roles.
rollback: Revert this governance-only authorization and stop or close all subordinate branches. The frozen ARC-WP-022 contract and RC718 product remain unchanged.

nextGate.purpose: After independently reviewed outputs from DEV-WP-031, KIT-WP-001 and QA-WP-011 exist, integrate them without editing role-owned files and prove the exact clean-generation candidate.
